name: Rosé Pine Dawn

provenance.bg.inset: spec: README 'Base: inactive tabs, sidebars' (no tone below Base; chrome bars go up to Surface)
provenance.bg.surface: spec: Surface = panels, inputs, popups, status bars
provenance.bg.raised: spec: Overlay = active/hovered list items, tabs
provenance.bg.overlay: spec (site): Overlay = elevated surfaces, e.g. tooltips, dialogs
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.05:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is invisible here, 1.00:1 vs inactive selection 1.10:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.default: spec: Text = high contrast foreground, body text
provenance.fg.muted: spec (site): Subtle = secondary text, labels, tab titles, inactive pane foreground
provenance.fg.faint: spec: Muted = comments, line numbers, disabled labels
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec (site): Gold search highlight 'paired with Base'; cross-scheme N1 on chromatic fills
provenance.fg.title: spec (site): Text = active tab/item foreground
provenance.border.default: spec: Highlight High = borders, visual dividers
provenance.border.focus: consensus: focused border pine 2/5 ports; port: rose-pine/kitty active_border_color = pine
provenance.accent.primary: spec: README Iris = links, hints; consensus accent iris 1/3
provenance.selection.bg: spec: Highlight Med = selection background (paired with Text)
provenance.selection.fg: spec: Text = selection foreground (paired with Highlight Med)
provenance.text-selection.bg: spec (site): Highlight Med = text selection background
provenance.cursor.bg: spec: Highlight High = cursor background; port: kitty cursor = highlightHigh
provenance.cursor.fg: spec: Text = cursor text (paired with Highlight High)
provenance.status.success: spec (site): Pine = constructive/affirmative signals, added content
provenance.search.match: spec (site): Gold = search/match highlights; consensus gold 2/2
provenance.statusbar.bg: spec (site): Surface = status bars, title bars
provenance.tab.inactive.fg: spec: Subtle = inactive tabs, tab titles
provenance.diff.added: spec (site): Pine = added content (README: Foam = git add)
provenance.diff.changed: spec: README Rose = git change; site Rose = modified content

notes: Discrepancy (role docs): rose-pine/palette README vs the newer rosepinetheme.com palette pages disagree on Pine/Foam/Rose. Rule used: the site (2025, more specific) wins; the README fills gaps (links = iris, active tabs). So success/added = pine (site), info = foam (both), changed = rose (both).

ANSI slot names are not hues: green = pine (teal-blue), blue = foam (cyan), cyan = rose (pink), magenta = iris. ansi16 overrides map tokens to the slot holding their palette color. Brights equal normals except bright black = muted.
bg.inset = base: the spec puts sidebars on Base and status/title bars on Surface (up, not down).

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): status.info -> '4' (slot 6 is 2.60:1; slot 6 #d7827e is not the #56949f hue; slot 4 = #56949f, 3.14:1) | accent.primary -> '5' (slot 4 is 3.14:1; slot 4 #56949f is not the #907aa9 hue; slot 5 = #907aa9, 3.47:1) | border.focus -> '2' (slot 2 is the closer match to #286983; slot 2 = #286983, 5.59:1) | keyhint.key -> '2' (slot 4 is 3.14:1; slot 2 = #286983, 5.59:1) | link -> '5 underline' (slot 4 is 3.14:1; slot 4 #56949f is not the #907aa9 hue; slot 5 = #907aa9, 3.47:1) | accent.secondary -> '2' (slot 5 #907aa9 is not the #286983 hue; slot 2 = #286983, 5.59:1) | mark -> '2' (slot 5 #907aa9 is not the #286983 hue; slot 2 = #286983, 5.59:1) | diff.changed -> '6' (slot 4 #56949f is not the #d7827e hue; slot 6 = #d7827e, 2.60:1) | fg.muted -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.47:1; now 6.66:1) | fg.faint -> '7' (default '8' resolves to 2.73:1; now 6.66:1) | keyhint.desc -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.47:1; now 6.66:1) | tab.inactive.fg -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.47:1; now 6.66:1) | tab.active.fg -> 'default bold' (active tab label = body text; bold separates it from dim inactive labels)
